plan.summary: Move the bulk-send configuration into the Proje (Project) as its own settings: add a CHANNEL (WhatsApp Cloud API instance) selector, a TEMPLATE selector with operator-filled parameters, and a message-kind toggle (wapcrm_template | plain_text) to project create/edit; persist them into the existing INERT projects cxapi columns; and REMOVE the per-list 'Gönder' send flow from the data-list (Listeler) page. Send EXECUTION stays unbuilt this slice (prod-inert, gate P0-3 untouched).
plan.q_intent: projenin ayarlarına kanal seçimi de ekle. o kanaldan gönderilecek. yalnız whatsapp api hatlarını göster listede. + şablon da proje ayarlarında seçilecek. + gönder özelliği data listesinde değil, projenin içinde olacak. data listesinden çıkart.
plan.interview_notes: AskUserQuestion 4/4 (2026-06-08): (1) Scope = UI-first — settings + persistence + remove list-send THIS slice; actual send-from-project execution = NEXT slice. (2) Channel filter = Cloud API only (instance_type = 1); types 2/5/6 hidden. (3) Message kind = template OR plain_text (kind toggle in project). (4) Template params = SUPPORTED — operator fills the template's requiredInputs (text/media) into param_mapping JSONB. Send execution, counters, and run dispatch remain deferred; gate stays closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Project create/edit modal has a channel selector listing ONLY WhatsApp Cloud API instances (instance_type === 1); selecting one persists projects.instance_id (the cxapi int instanceID).

Project create/edit has a message-kind toggle: 'wapcrm_template' shows a template picker (templates fetched per selected channel via GET /api/v1/settings/wa-templates?instanceId=) and renders inputs for the template's requiredInputs; 'plain_text' hides the template picker. Persists template_kind.

For wapcrm_template, the selected template persists to projects.wa_template_id and the operator-entered requiredInputs persist to projects.param_mapping (JSONB); GET detail returns them so edit re-populates.

Backend/Outbound CRUD persists & returns the cxapi config columns (instance_id, template_kind, wa_template_id, template_language, param_mapping) with server-side validation (kind in {plain_text,wapcrm_template}; wapcrm_template requires positive instance_id + non-empty wa_template_id; instance_id positive when present); invalid input returns a typed INV-OB code, never silent.
The per-list 'Gönder' button and the 'Listeye Gönder' send modal are removed from DataImportPage (Listeler); data-list import/list management otherwise unchanged; no dead imports/handlers left.
Send EXECUTION is NOT wired this slice: no code reads projects.instance_id/wa_template_id to dispatch a send; gate P0-3 (CxapiSend default-OFF) and allowlist are untouched; full solution build PASS.

files_changed.change: Added ProjectTemplateKinds constant; added send-config fields (instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/template_language/param_mapping) to ProjectSummary + Create/UpdateProjectRequest
SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE handle cxapi config columns; ProjectSendConfigInput carrier; AddSendConfigParams typed-param helper; MapSummary reads cols 16-20 (param_mapping jsonb->JsonElement)
BuildSendConfig validator (kind-driver, channel required, plain_text clears template fields, param_mapping JSON object/array + size cap); wired into Create/Update + no-change guard
ProjectStatus + ProjectMessage switch arms for INV-OB-073
ProjectTemplateKind/ProjectTemplateParam/WaTemplate types; config fields on Project types + requests; getWaTemplates()

Modal: channel selector (Cloud API only, instance_type===1) + kind toggle + template picker (per channel) + requiredInputs params; persist + edit re-populate; save validation incl. unloaded-template guard
Removed per-list 'Gönder' button + SendModal component + sendList state + dead imports (Send/OutboundTemplateDto/BulkSendStatusResponse)

build.command: npm run build (tsc+vite) [Dashboard SPA] + dotnet build InvektoServis.sln -c Release

verification_questions.question: Does the channel selector restrict to WhatsApp Cloud API (instance_type === 1) and store the cxapi integer instanceID into projects.instance_id, and is the value validated positive server-side before persistence?
Is the project CRUD that writes the new cxapi config columns still tenant-scoped (tenant_id in every WHERE/INSERT) so one tenant cannot set or read another tenant's channel/template config?

When template_kind='wapcrm_template' but wa_template_id is empty or instance_id is missing/non-positive, does the service reject with a typed INV-OB error code (not a silent default or a 500), and does plain_text correctly skip the template requirement?

After removing the data-list send flow, are all now-unused imports/state/handlers/api calls (confirmBulkSend, BulkSendStatusResponse, Send icon, preview-from-list) cleaned up so DataImportPage still compiles and the list/import lifecycle is intact?

forbidden_areas: arch/db/migrations/* (no schema change — 057 columns already exist)
non_goals: Actual send-from-project execution (project -> broadcast -> cxapi send) — next slice
Run dispatch / bulk_send_jobs.project_id population — next slice
Counter recompute from runs — stays INERT
Opening the live-enablement gate / allowlisting any tenant
intentional_exclusions: plain_text message body field — text is entered at send time (next slice); plain_text project stores only kind + channel now
template_language — WapCrmTemplateDto has no language field (language is embedded in templateId slug per INMA G13); stored null/unused this slice
dynamic-button URL params — deferred per prior PR-4 decision

user_facing_errors: INV-OB project channel/template validation errors surfaced via errText in ProjectsPage modal
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All new validation paths return typed INV-OB codes mapped to HTTP status; the frontend surfaces them via errText. Template fetch failure shows an inline error and disables template selection rather than silently saving an empty template.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operatör hangi WhatsApp hattından gönderileceğini bilemiyor, yanlış hattan gönderim riski var.
aha_moments.suggestion: Kanal dropdown'unda hat adı + numarayı göster, sadece Cloud API hatları; tek hat varsa otomatik seç.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operatör projeyi açtığında doğru WhatsApp hattının zaten seçili/net olduğunu görür.

aha_moments.user_pain: Şablon parametreleri eksik gönderilirse WhatsApp reddeder, operatör nedenini anlamaz.
aha_moments.suggestion: requiredInputs için zorunlu alan validasyonu + her input'un note/hint'ini göster; eksikse kaydetmeyi engelle.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operatör kaydetmeden önce hangi parametrenin eksik olduğunu tam görür.

aha_moments.user_pain: Gönderim data listesinde olunca 'liste = kampanya' karışıyordu; aynı liste birden çok kampanyada kullanılınca kafa karışıyor.
aha_moments.suggestion: Gönderimi projeye taşı; liste sadece veri, proje = kampanya birimi.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operatör 'liste veri, proje gönderim' ayrımını ilk projede net kavrar.

aha_moments.user_pain: Şablon listesi her seferinde cxapi'den çekilince yavaş.
aha_moments.suggestion: Kanal seçilince şablonları bir kez çek + modal içinde cache'le; kanal değişince yeniden çek.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operatör kanal seçer seçmez şablonların anında listelendiğini görür.

aha_moments.user_pain: Yanlış kanal/şablon kaydı sonradan fark edilince destek gerekiyor.
aha_moments.suggestion: Proje detayında seçili kanal + şablon adını özet kartta göster (edit'e girmeden).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operatör proje listesinde/özetinde kanal+şablonu görüp yanlışı anında yakalar.

verdict.escalation_reason: iter0 FAIL = REAL (channel restriction client-side only) -> fixed with authoritative server-side ValidateChannelOwnershipAsync (tenant-scoped + instance_type=1). iter1 FAIL = FALSE-POSITIVE (Codex stateless/diff-only flagged the sanctioned shared-Postgres tenant_instances read as cross-service isolation violation + missing schema evidence). iter2 PASS after corrected-premise re-review (single shared Postgres per arch/tenant-isolation.md; Outbound already reads tenant_registry via GetWapCrmSettingsAsync; schema attested tenant-instances.sql + migration 057). 12/12 CQ + 4/4 CoVe PASS, 0 blockers. NOT a FORCE PASS.
